title: Universal Mathematics Infinite Term Registry

integer_domain.generation_rule: For any requested integer n, emit a deterministic record for n; the domain has no finite upper or lower bound.

five_term_families.name: Integer Terms
five_term_families.generator: n -> n for any integer n

five_term_families.name: Natural/Counting Terms
five_term_families.definition: Counting values; convention about including zero must be declared per context.
five_term_families.generator: n -> n for n >= 0 under this registry's default convention

five_term_families.name: Rational Terms
five_term_families.definition: Values representable as p/q for p integer and q nonzero integer.
five_term_families.generator: (p,q) -> p/q, q != 0; reduce by gcd and normalize denominator sign

five_term_families.name: Real Terms
five_term_families.definition: Real quantities including rational and irrational values.
five_term_families.generator: symbolic expression, exact algebraic representation, or explicitly bounded approximation

five_term_families.name: Complex Terms
five_term_families.definition: Values a+bi for real a,b with i^2=-1.

infinite_dataset_policy: Store definitions, generators, constraints, and finite materialized windows rather than an impossible infinite list.
